cefrAlignment: Matches B2 overall: 150–300-word recordings across everyday, campus, workplace and academic contexts with paraphrase and change-of-plan distractors, consistent with the B2 course lessons.
examFidelity: IELTS Parts 1–4 (form completion, 3-option MCQ, who-says-it matching, note completion), TOEIC Part 3 with a graphic, a TOEIC Part 4 talk and a 194-word TOEFL Academic Talk with four question types all match exams.ts; the 39 questions follow the audio order, and 40 minutes is realistic.
fixes: Q2: removed 'off peak' and 'offpeak' from the accepted answers, because the limit is ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER and only the hyphenated 'off-peak' counts as one word (ielts.org).
Q4: removed 'Tuesdays', because 'Tuesdays evenings' is ungrammatical in the form line '___ evenings'.

Section 7 facts verified: night migration of songbirds, the benefits of cooler air, daytime feeding and fewer predators, planetarium star-compass experiments (Emlen, indigo buntings) and lights-out programmes in cities.
openConcerns: Section 4's numbered headings (1–4) sit inside questions 22–29 and may confuse some learners; this is cosmetic.
learnerOutcome: A learner can take a mixed IELTS/TOEIC/TOEFL listening test under exam conditions, get a reliable B2 score out of 39, and see which course lessons to review.
